security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, relative documentation links, scientific terms, and reference URLs. The helper scripts write explicit output files and optionally run a fixed packmol command without shell interpolation. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or hidden malicious behavior was found.

content.value_statement: Preparing molecular dynamics starting structures requires precise Packmol syntax and geometry choices. This skill helps create inputs, solvation setups, interfaces, and validation steps for Packmol workflows.
actual_capabilities: Draft Packmol inputs for boxes, mixtures, solvation, interfaces, and constrained geometries.
Explain Packmol constraints such as box, sphere, cylinder, plane, and ellipsoid.
Adapt bundled templates and examples for common molecular packing tasks.
Recommend validation steps for inputs, overlaps, density, and Packmol success checks.
Estimate practical protein solvation settings such as shell size, ions, and periodic boxes.
limitations: It does not provide molecule structure files or force-field parameters.
Generated inputs still need scientific review before production simulations.
Helper scripts use simple PDB parsing and may not cover every topology.
It does not replace specialized membrane builders or downstream MD setup tools.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Solvent Box
use_cases.description: Create a clear Packmol plan for single-component or mixed-solvent boxes.

use_cases.title: Solvate a Biomolecule
use_cases.description: Set up water, ions, box dimensions, and validation checks for a protein system.

use_cases.title: Build Interface Systems
use_cases.description: Design liquid-liquid or liquid-vapor interfaces with plane constraints and density checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Water Box
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a simple solvent box.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Packmol input for 500 water molecules in a 30 angstrom cubic box. Include validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Mixed Solvent
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup with two molecule types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Packmol plan for an 80:20 water ethanol mixture in a 40 angstrom box.

prompt_templates.title: Solvate a Protein
prompt_templates.prompt: Help solvate protein.pdb with a 15 angstrom shell, neutralizing ions, and 0.15 M salt.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Convergence
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced debugging for a failed packing run.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Packmol constraints and explain why packing may not converge. Suggest safe parameter changes.

output_examples.input: User asks for a 1000-water simulation box.
output_examples.output: A Packmol setup plan with tolerance, box dimensions, structure count, output name, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: User asks to solvate a charged protein.
output_examples.output: A protein solvation workflow with shell size, estimated ions, periodic box guidance, and success checks.

output_examples.input: User reports a failed interface packing run.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting summary covering constraint conflicts, molecule counts, tolerance, and incremental testing.

best_practices: Start with small molecule counts before scaling to large production systems.
Set a reproducible seed when comparing packing outcomes.
Validate output geometry with overlap and density checks before MD setup.
anti_patterns: Do not assume Packmol output is physically equilibrated.
Do not use incompatible molecule files without checking atom names and formats.
Do not increase molecule counts before resolving constraint conflicts.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Packmol inputs for molecular boxes, solvation systems, interfaces, and constrained geometries.

faq.question: Can it run Packmol for me?
faq.answer: It can guide command use, but Packmol must be installed and run in your own environment.

faq.question: Does it generate force-field files?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on initial coordinates and Packmol input structure, not force-field assignment.

faq.question: Can it help with failed convergence?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review constraints, molecule counts, tolerance, and staged packing options.

faq.question: Which file formats are covered?
faq.answer: The included guidance focuses on Packmol PDB, XYZ, and Tinker input formats.

faq.question: Is scientific validation still required?
faq.answer: Yes. Review density, overlaps, chemistry, and downstream MD settings before production use.
